nodes.summary: For a code $c$ of a partial recursive function, the description length of $c$ is the number of binary digits of the encoding of $c$ as a natural number, that is, the least $k$ such that this encoding is less than $2^k$ (so it is $0$ when the encoding is $0$).
nodes.title: Description length of a code

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$ there is a code $c$ of a partial recursive function whose evaluation is defined exactly at $n$, that is, the domain of the partial function computed by $c$ is $\{n\}$.
nodes.title: Codes with singleton domain

nodes.summary: For every code $c$ of a partial recursive function there is a minimal code $D$ whose domain equals the domain of $c$, where the domain of a code is the set of inputs on which its evaluation is defined.
nodes.title: Every language of a code has a minimal code

nodes.summary: For every natural number $N$ there is a minimal code $D$ of a partial recursive function whose encoding as a natural number is greater than $N$.
nodes.title: Minimal codes are unbounded

nodes.summary: A code $c$ of a partial recursive function is minimal when no code with a shorter description has the same domain: for every code $d$ whose description length is strictly less than that of $c$, the domain of $d$ (the set of inputs on which its evaluation is defined) differs from the domain of $c$. The set of minimal codes is denoted $\mathrm{MIN}$.
nodes.title: Minimal codes

nodes.summary: The set $\mathrm{MIN}$ of minimal codes of partial recursive functions is not recognizable by a multi-stack Turing machine: there is no finite multi-stack machine that, for every code $c$, halts on the binary encoding of the natural-number encoding of $c$ exactly when $c$ is minimal.
nodes.title: Minimal codes are not recognizable

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
